one_liner: Vladimir Guerrero Jr. hit the ball hard as a rule in 2025: 86.2 mph average exit velocity across 752 batted balls.
three_things: Real top-end power too: 90th-percentile exit velocity 108.5 mph.
That translated to a .386 estimated wOBA on contact.
He saw 2,450 pitches -- 26.9% four-seam fastballs, 50.8% in the rulebook zone.
context_note: Descriptive only, from a single 2025 Statcast pull (>=300 pitches-faced floor). Contact numbers are over the 752 batted balls only, not all 2,450 pitches, and estimated wOBA on contact is a batted-ball model -- it ignores walks and strikeouts. No swing/miss or launch-angle column in this pull, so no whiff rate or barrel profile. Not park- or opponent-adjusted; not a prediction.
